description: Artist profile by MBID: type (person/group/…), country, life span, gender, area, aliases, tags/genres, plus the discography (release-groups) and band-membership / collaboration relationships and external links (Wikidata QID, Discogs, official site — surfaced as url-rels chainable to those servers). The 80% artist-detail call. Discography and relationships are capped at one page (25); for a prolific artist's complete release-group list, call musicbrainz_browse_entities with target_type=release-group and the artist link.

inc_relationships.description: Include band-membership / collaboration relationships and external links (url-rels).

inc_release_groups.description: Include the discography (release-groups). Capped at one page; use browse for the full set.

name: musicbrainz_get_artist

items.description: An alternate name for the entity.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale of the alias. Omitted when absent.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary alias for its locale. Omitted when absent.

sortName.description: Sortable form of the alias. Omitted when absent.

type.description: Alias type (e.g. "Artist name", "Legal name"). Omitted when absent.

area.description: Associated area name. Omitted when unknown.

cap.description: The one-page cap that was applied. Absent when not truncated.

country.description: ISO country code. Omitted when unknown.

disambiguation.description: Short qualifier distinguishing same-named artists. Omitted when absent.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_mbid`: The MBID is malformed or the all-zeros sentinel (MusicBrainz returns HTTP 400). `entity_not_found`: The MBID is well-formed but no artist exists with it (MusicBrainz returns HTTP 404). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

externalLinks.description: External resource links (url-rels) — Wikidata, Discogs, official site (may be empty).

items.description: An external resource link (url-rel). Where cross-service IDs like Wikidata QID are surfaced.

resource.description: The external URL. Wikidata/Discogs IDs live in the URL path — chain to those servers.

gender.description: Gender, for person-type artists. Omitted when unknown/inapplicable.

lifeSpan.description: Birth/death or formation/dissolution span. Omitted when unknown.

begin.description: Start date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted when unknown.

ended.description: Whether the entity has ended. Omitted when the upstream value is unknown/null.

notice.description: How to fetch the complete discography when truncated.

relationships.description: Band membership and collaboration relationships (may be empty).

items.description: A typed relationship to another entity (band membership, performer, writer, etc.).

attributes.description: Role modifiers (e.g. "lead vocals", "assistant", "co"). Omitted when none.

begin.description: Relationship start date. Omitted when absent.

end.description: Relationship end date. Omitted when absent.

targetId.description: MBID of the related entity — chain to the matching get_* tool. Omitted for url targets.

targetName.description: Name/title of the related entity. Omitted when absent.

releaseGroups.description: Discography — release-groups (one page; may be empty or capped).

items.description: A release-group in the artist discography (capped to one page — use browse for all).

primaryType.description: Primary type (Album, Single, EP, …). Omitted when absent.

secondaryTypes.description: Secondary types (Live, Compilation, …). Omitted when none.

shown.description: Number of release-groups returned. Absent when not truncated.

sortName.description: Sortable name form. Omitted when absent.

tags.description: Community tags/genres with vote counts (may be empty).

items.description: A folksonomy tag or genre with its vote count.

count.description: Community vote count for this tag.

truncated.description: True when the discography hit the one-page cap and more release-groups exist. Absent when the full set fit in one page.

type.description: Artist type (Person, Group, Orchestra, …). Omitted when unknown.

title: musicbrainz-mcp-server: get artist
